evaluations.model_answer: Пунктираната линия на тренда показва низходяща тенденция през второто полугодие на 2024 г.
evaluations.judge_reasoning: The model incorrectly described the non-existent element as if it exists and provided an analysis of its trend, failing to recognize that the dotted trend line is not present in the chart.
